chunks: 1 – Bakr ibn Salih al-Razi. (Very weak). Narrated many strange reports exclusively.

key_terms.التَّفَرُّدِ: Exclusivity, narrating a hadith alone without other corroborating chains
key_terms.الْغَرَائِبِ: Strange/rare reports, hadiths that are unique or unusual
key_terms.بَكْرُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ: Bakr ibn Salih, a specific narrator
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ جِدًّا: Very weak, a high degree of weakness in narrator reliability

ai.seo_question: What is the status of Bakr ibn Salih al-Razi in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry provides a biographical assessment of the narrator Bakr ibn Salih al-Razi, classifying him as 'very weak' (da'if jiddan) in hadith sciences. It highlights his characteristic of frequently narrating unique, rare, or strange reports (gharib) exclusively, which is a key factor in evaluating his reliability.
